optimizedContext.value:
# GetGuideQuery — guide topic lookup

## Rules

### GetGuideQuery
- App layer MUST implement `GetGuideQuery`; ctor receives `GuideCatalogPort` instance.
- Input: `{ topic: string }`.
- Hit -> return full `GuideTopic` entity: title, description, content, section outline.
- Lookup case-insensitive.

### Normalization today (verbatim order)
- Query (`get-guide-query.ts`): `raw = input.topic ?? ''` -> `trim()` -> if `endsWith('.md')` `slice(0,-3)` -> `toLowerCase()`; passes `normalized` to `catalogPort.getGuide`.
- Adapter (`prebundled-guide-catalog-adapter.ts`): `topic.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\.md$/,'')` -> O(1) `this.index[normalized]`; miss => `null`.
- `.md` strip is case-SENSITIVE in query (checked pre-lowercase), case-INSENSITIVE in adapter (stripped post-lowercase). `.MD` resolves only via adapter re-normalization — accidental, unspecified.
- `:` is NOT special: `collection:topic` (`core:ports`, `sdk:index`) passes through both layers verbatim into flat index lookup.

### Topic Not Found
- Guard: `normalized.length === 0` -> skip lookup, throw immediately.
- Miss -> `catalogPort.listGuides()` -> `all.map(g => g.topic)`.
- Throw `GuideTopicNotFoundError(topic, availableTopics)`.
- `error.code === 'UNKNOWN_GUIDE_TOPIC'`; `error.topic` = RAW untrimmed input; `error.availableTopics` = full ID array.
- Message: empty-after-trim -> `Guide topic cannot be empty.`; else `Guide topic '<topic>' not found.`; suffix ` Available topics: <joined>`.

## Constraints
- Pure app query; deps only `GuideCatalogPort` + domain models/errors. No infra imports.
- Normalization duplicated in query AND adapter; must remain idempotent under composition.
- Generator derives topic as `path.basename(filePath,'.md').toLowerCase()` over a FLAT dir (`readdirSync` + `isFile()`, no recursion) -> basename-only keys, no collection scoping.
